name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@first_diagnosis
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma is the first diagnosis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma is the first diagnosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma is not the first diagnosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis is the first.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@diagnosed_according_to_global_initiative_for_asthma_recommendations
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was made according to Global Initiative for Asthma recommendations.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was made according to Global Initiative for Asthma recommendations.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of asthma was not made according to Global Initiative for Asthma recommendations.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis was made according to Global Initiative for Asthma recommendations.

name: patient_has_finding_of_wheezing_inthehistory

when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of wheezing.

when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of dyspnea (shortness of breath).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of dyspnea (shortness of breath).

name: patient_has_finding_of_tight_chest_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of chest tightness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of chest tightness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of chest tightness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of chest tightness.

name: patient_has_finding_of_cough_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of cough.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of cough.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of cough.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of cough.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_smoke_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of exposure to smoke.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of exposure to smoke.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of exposure to smoke.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of exposure to smoke.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_mold_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of exposure to mold.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of exposure to mold.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of exposure to mold.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of exposure to mold.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_vehicular_traffic_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of exposure to vehicular traffic.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a documented history of exposure to vehicular traffic.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a documented history of exposure to vehicular traffic.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of exposure to vehicular traffic.

name: patient_has_undergone_spirometry_now@@at_baseline
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone spirometry now and the procedure was performed at baseline.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone spirometry now and the procedure was performed at baseline.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone spirometry now but not at baseline.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the spirometry was performed at baseline.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_liters@@at_baseline
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's FEV1 measured now and taken at baseline.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate or not at baseline.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's FEV1 is recorded now and the measurement was taken at baseline.

name: patient_forced_vital_capacity_value_recorded_now_withunit_liters@@at_baseline
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's FVC measured now and taken at baseline.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate or not at baseline.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's FVC is recorded now and the measurement was taken at baseline.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_after_bronchodilator_withunit_liters
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1) measured after bronchodilator inhalation, in liters.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1) is recorded after bronchodilator inhalation in liters.

name: patient_has_undergone_skin_prick_test_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone a skin prick test now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone a skin prick test now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone a skin prick test now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone a skin prick test now.

name: patient_has_history_of_respiratory_symptoms
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of respiratory symptoms.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a history of respiratory symptoms, including but not limited to history of wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, or cough.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a history of respiratory symptoms as defined.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of respiratory symptoms.

name: patient_has_history_of_environmental_exposures
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a history of environmental exposures.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a history of environmental exposures, including but not limited to smoke, mold, or vehicular traffic.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a history of environmental exposures as defined.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the patient has a history of environmental exposures.

name: patient_spirometry_fev1_fvc_ratio_below_0_90_at_baseline
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's FEV1/FVC ratio at baseline is less than 0.90.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's FEV1/FVC ratio at baseline is less than 0.90.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's FEV1/FVC ratio at baseline is greater than or equal to 0.90.
when_unknown: Set to null if the ratio cannot be determined.

name: patient_spirometry_fev1_increase_after_bronchodilator_gt_12_percent
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's FEV1 increase from baseline after bronchodilator inhalation is greater than 12%.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's FEV1 increase from baseline after bronchodilator inhalation is greater than 12%.
when_false: Set to false if the increase is less than or equal to 12%.
when_unknown: Set to null if the increase cannot be determined.

name: patient_spirometry_criteria_met
meaning: Boolean indicating whether both spirometry criteria are met.
when_true: Set to true if both FEV1/FVC < 0.90 at baseline and FEV1 increase after bronchodilator > 12% are satisfied.
when_false: Set to false if either is not satisfied.
when_unknown: Set to null if either cannot be determined.

name: patient_asthma_diagnosis_criteria_met
meaning: Boolean indicating whether all required criteria for first diagnosis of asthma according to GINA are met.
when_true: Set to true if all required assessments for first diagnosis of asthma according to GINA are satisfied.
when_false: Set to false if any required assessment is not satisfied.
when_unknown: Set to null if any required assessment cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_finding_of_acute_asthma_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had episodes of acute asthma (asthma exacerbations) within the past four weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had one or more episodes of acute asthma (asthma exacerbations) within the past four weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had any episodes of acute asthma (asthma exacerbations) within the past four weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had episodes of acute asthma (asthma exacerbations) within the past four weeks.

name: patient_has_finding_of_acute_asthma_inthepast4weeks@@required_oral_corticosteroid_therapy
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's acute asthma exacerbations within the past four weeks required oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's acute asthma exacerbations within the past four weeks required oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's acute asthma exacerbations within the past four weeks did not require oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's acute asthma exacerbations within the past four weeks required oral corticosteroid therapy.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_leukotriene_receptor_antagonist_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has been exposed to a leukotriene receptor antagonist within the past four weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has been exposed to a leukotriene receptor antagonist at any time within the past four weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not been exposed to a leukotriene receptor antagonist within the past four weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has been exposed to a leukotriene receptor antagonist within the past four weeks.

name: patient_has_undergone_inhaled_steroid_therapy_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy at any time within the past four weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.

name: patient_has_finding_of_respiratory_tract_infection_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had a respiratory tract infection within the past four weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had a respiratory tract infection at any time within the past four weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had a respiratory tract infection at any time within the past four weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had a respiratory tract infection within the past four weeks.
